title: The Pale Hymn
author: Quentin Brightwater
blurb: Juniper Winterbourne, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
